Messages.Author: Petri Wessman
Messages.Body:
I was looking at Kraken's Kiss:

Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Vicissitude
Strike: strength+1 ranged damage. If this striking minion
takes more than 3 damage this combat, he or she goes to
torpor. (S) As above, with an optional press, only usable to
continue combat, and once each round for the remainder of
combat, this vampire may strike to steal two blood at close or
long range.

The superior effect says "once each round for the remainder of the
combat". Does this also apply to the current round, i.e. can I play
KK, and then use the steal blood strike as an additional strike
(assuming I get an additional from somewhere)?

//Petri

Messages.Author: Dorian
Messages.Body:



Card text doesnt prohibit it later in the same round, so Yes.
